prompts.name: fractured-glass
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production grayscale UI material texture for a premium mobile military strategy game. Generate one square orthographic flat surface filling the entire image, no perspective or surrounding environment. Fractured armored glass: large irregular polygonal glass facets, sharp branching impact fractures biased toward corners and edges, fine secondary cracks, subtle reflective bevels. Center kept calm but texture still visible. No bullet hole, no stars, no debris, no frame. Grayscale neutral only, primarily light silver gray with white highlights and medium/dark gray material detail; no color. This texture will be multiplied by existing green/red/blue/gold UI gradients so avoid broad black areas. Material detail must remain recognizable on a small button. Edge to edge opaque square surface; seamless-looking boundaries; no text, no watermark, no button shape, no border, no symbols.
